Create "Small bug fixes and tweaks" plan in docs/plans/p102_small-bug-fixes-and-tweaks.md

Category: Bug, Refactor

Fix or tweak these list items:
- When loading the page the browser console warns: "using deprecated parameters for the initialization function; pass a single object instead". There is an issue for this but it seems to be closed/solved: https://github.com/dimforge/rapier/issues/811 . Maybe updating Rapier could help.
- If a custom domain Spatial index has wirefame set on and we change a scene the console warns: Calling [RenderPassEncoder (unlabeled)].Draw with a vertex count of 0 is unusual. This should be fixed (probably is trying to draw lines for something that isn't there).

If any of these fixes/tweaks are large refactorings/fixes then produce a plan for those.

If for some reason this plan can't or shouldn't be created with this specification or has some high risks of failing the implementation, notify immediately. You are allowed to change the naming of the plan or the header information if they are not well described, but please notify about this.

Create "Fog system" plan in docs/plans/p102_fog-system.md

Category: Fog

Create a fog system for Aekasha. The debugger drawer should have its own  Fog system tab (design an icon for this) and each fog setup should be scene specific. It should be toggleable on/off (the whole system) and it should have at least three different fog passes available to choose from (or notify if some of these should not be implemented, or something else would be beneficial for Aekasha):
- Basic Three.js fog (simple fog)
- Three.js FogExp2
- Global volumetric fog (or something like it)
Also all the parameters for the fog should be editable in the debugger drawer. It can be defined in its own file: myScene.fog.json.

Context from the removed sky box plans (p110-p115; full texts in git history): fog coupling with the sky box was an explicit non-goal of the sky box epic, so it is open for this plan. The sky box's `ground` layer already has `useAtmosphereHorizon` (blends toward the atmosphere's horizon colour, a form of aerial perspective), and the day-night cycle changes the horizon colour over time, so consider a fog colour that can follow the active sky box. Screen-space passes belong in the PostFX chain (`core/PostFX.ts`). Headless WebGPU doesn't render under WSL2, so visual checks need a real browser.

If for some reason this plan can't or shouldn't be created with this specification or has some high risks of failing the implementation, notify immediately. You are allowed to change the naming of the plan or the header information if they are not well described, but please notify about this.

UNDER_CONSTRUCTION
Create "Static mesh merging and texture atlas systems" plan in docs/plans/p370_static-mesh-merging-and-texture-atlas-systems.md

Category: Merging, Texture atlas

To improve optimization and performance (and to enable larger worlds with lowering the draw count) we need to have a feature to merge static meshes together. I am not sure if this should consern only static meshes so it needs to be studied if some others can also be merged to reduce draw count.

In debug mode we should see somehow that a static (physics or not physics) entity consists of these meshes and that they are merged. We will later implement a select/transform tools for the debug mode so we should still be able to select and transform the individual meshes and then remerge them after the transform so that should be taken into account.

I am not sure but maybe we could set a merge option for the created/imported meshes/geometries, like for example merge: [groupId or "AUTO"] or something like that. This would then create a group for the merged meshes and would then create one large mesh to be rendered. I think we need to have two tools: one for merging only geometries and one merging meshes.

When mergin meshes I think they need to share the same material, right? This needs to studied that is it possible to merge several meshes with different materials together and how much does it complicate things and what are the performance costs. This also introduces the need to have the possibility to use texture atlases (for each map type in the material, meaning also normal maps, ao maps, etc. should have their own atlases but they should be linked to that "merge" material). I don't know again if necessary but if needed, the atlas system should work also without merging meshes, so that if the developer wishes to create some custom atlases, they can do so.

This plan (or plans) will be implemented after the LOD plans and check whether this can be implemented before the terrain plans (or some other) or if this should can be done before them. Does these systems also provide some new ways to create terrains? If yes, then that should be noted in the terrain plans that desribe the different processes about creating terrains.

There are for sure several plans worth of material to create so please divide the work to several plans.

If for some reason this plan can't or shouldn't be created with this specification or has some high risks of failing the implementation, notify immediately. You are allowed to change the naming of the plan or the header information if they are not well described, but please notify about this.
